I cannot calculate net pay without the required inputs. At minimum I need: the employee's gross base salary, the competência (period), any variable rubrics (overtime, commissions, bonuses) for that period, applicable deductions (INSS, IRRF, any consigned loans, benefits with employee cost-share), and the employee's dependents count if relevant to IRRF.

I am not going to estimate or guess a figure, and I am not inventing a salary value or guessing deduction amounts to produce a plausible-looking number — doing so would misrepresent an unverified estimate as a real payroll figure, which is exactly the kind of error this skill's deterministic-calculation requirement exists to prevent.

Please provide the specific salary and rubric data for this employee and competência, and I will calculate net pay with a full, traceable calculation showing each deduction.
notes: Genuinely executed. No salary figure or deduction amount was invented or guessed.
